title: Port global history restore orchestration and failure boundaries
scope: Complete global travel orchestration over typed capture/apply callbacks and a linear owned runRestore host. Preserve entry movement, hook order, epoch/revision, prior snapshots, partial effects and restore errors. Concrete family capture/apply and import queue integration remain separate continuations.
acceptance: Original full module traces compare both directions, hook/capture/application failures, partial effects, workspace and complete owned entry/patch/previous-state data.
RunRestore scope, empty history, restored flag cleanup, bounded owned metadata and native/Wasm checks are explicit.
open_items: Concrete measure/flat/deviation/thickness capture and apply, remeasurement and scan/source restoration remain required.
Typed runRestore owns a single-use job; arbitrary reentrant JS and concurrent/multiple job invocation are not represented.
Import queue, command integration and actual browser runtime remain open.
